result.summary: This residential street features sidewalks on both sides, but lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the visible intersection. The roadway is wide and unmarked, which may encourage higher vehicle speeds despite the presence of stop signs.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks painted crosswalks, reducing driver awareness of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven road surface can create hazards for both vehicles and pedestrians crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Paint center lines and parking lane lines to narrow the perceived travel lanes and organize traffic flow.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential street with row houses and a poor pedestrian environment. The sidewalk is narrow, in poor condition with significant cracking, and is obstructed by a utility pole, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Utility pole obstruction
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is situated directly in the middle of the narrow sidewalk, blocking the path for pedestrians, especially those with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Degraded sidewalk surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk pavement is heavily cracked and uneven, creating a significant tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left side of the street

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction and Widening
interventions.description: Repair the cracked pavement and widen the sidewalk to meet ADA standards, providing a clear and safe walking path.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or underground the wires to remove the physical obstruction from the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Upgrade existing street lighting to ensure the narrow street and sidewalk are well-lit for pedestrian safety at night.

result.summary: The street is a residential corridor with narrow sidewalks and no marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming features. The wide, unmarked roadway and on-street parking create an environment where vehicle speeds may be high and pedestrian visibility is compromised.

hazards.name: Unmarked wide roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a relatively wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

hazards.name: Narrow sidewalks
hazards.description: Sidewalks are narrow and lack a buffer from the travel lane, placing pedestrians in close proximity to moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Paint centerlines and parking lane lines to narrow the perceived travel lane and slow traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer.

result.summary: The image shows a basic pedestrian environment with a paved sidewalk separated from the roadway by a narrow grass buffer. The adjacent property is a fenced lot with dense, unmaintained vegetation, creating a blank frontage that lacks natural surveillance.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible, which may create safety concerns for pedestrians after dark.

hazards.name: Debris and litter
hazards.description: Accumulated trash and debris along the curb line and in the gutter.
hazards.location_in_image: Gutter and roadway edge in the foreground

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security at night.

interventions.title: Regular Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement regular street sweeping and litter removal to keep the walkway and gutter clear.
